reason: An OAuth adapter that connects a ChatGPT Codex subscription to DeepSeek Harness, with browser or terminal login and local credential storage; human review is appropriate because it handles account credentials and describes unofficial third-party subscription use.

summaries.en: An OAuth adapter that connects a ChatGPT Codex subscription to DeepSeek Harness with browser or terminal login and local credential storage.
